player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I repeatedly used the wrong verb ("take") to pick up items and ignored the specific custom actions ("ortid", "enerk", "alism") provided in the instructions. I also got stuck in a loop trying to pick up the plate in the kitchen without success. Next time, I will immediately test the three custom actions ("ortid", "enerk", "alism") on the target items (delly, plate, penol) to see which one successfully picks them up. Once an item is picked up, I will use the correct custom action to place it in its destination (thot, micon, table) rather than guessing standard verbs like "put" or "place". I will also verify the exact spelling of all objects and locations from the game master's descriptions before acting.
